title: TaskClassification
description: Output of the task-class-routing skill: deterministic classification of a Claude Code task into one of five tiers based on the signal ladder over prompt, files in scope, and tool plan.

class.description: The classification tier. Ordered low-to-high cost: trivial < small < feature < system < audit. 'audit' is terminal — once set, no upgrade or downgrade is permitted.

rationale.description: Short explanation of why this class was chosen. Max 140 characters.

signals_used.description: Ordered list of every rung in the signal ladder that fired. Deduplicated. Drawn from the controlled vocabulary below.

files_in_scope.description: Number of distinct files mentioned in the prompt or globbed by the caller. 0 is valid (e.g., research task with no specific files).

loc_estimate.description: LOC delta estimate used in Rung 4. Null when no estimate was available.

tie_break_applied.description: True when conflicting signals forced an upgrade to the higher tier (e.g., trivial_kw matched but file-count > 5).
